fact: On 17 August 2026 the Bamako Court of Appeal sentenced Mohamed Youssouf Bathily and Rokia Doumbia to ten years, three suspended, for undermining the credibility of the state through communication technologies over broadcast comments, and Youssouf Sissoko was sentenced in March 2026 to two years for an article.
title: Mali's shrinking civic space: imprisonments, bans, and the silencing of independent media
